cases.title: From an answer, practice (Set the pivot already learned): Shake Control, a null that expressions move and that carries the rock and the letters, is the focus with no intent question; a Pan Behind that also moved rock.png gets a hint naming rock.png and its way (no fail words, no review); the clean Pan Behind passes on the layers it carries not moving, and the last line hands back to the next step

checks.detail: turn 5: "That was step 3; next is Play it back and watch the turn"

rubric.reason: Turn 1 is one sentence picking up on the layer ("We're on Shake Control, so the shake turns from the spot you picked on the art.") and then the A, then Shift+P ask, with no intent question, no proposal, no memory clause and no idea stated yet.

Turn 3 says "Shake Control's pivot moved, but rock.png moved with it, to the right. Edit > Undo, then try Pan Behind (Y) with Shake Control selected." and fixes nothing; Turn 4 calls it done because none of the carried layers moved, and no turn grades where the pivot sits on the art.
No turn says review, test, failed, wrong, not quite or "you already learned this"; Turn 3 states the miss plainly as what moved and which way.
Turn 5 ends on "That was step 3; next is Play it back and watch the turn.", which matches the record's hand_back step_number 3 and next_step, with nothing after it.

Every name the mentor uses (Shake Control, rock.png, logo.png, Anchor Point, Position) appears in the snapshot or check results, "the hammer end" is the learner's own words, and the mentor mentions no times.
